description: This file contains helper functions and classes for interacting with Congress.gov data, including managing cache, retrieving bills, converting years to Congress numbers, checking API keys, and downloading bill texts. It includes functions for fetching bills by type, candidate bill retrieval, and processing bill text choices, tailored for use within the OpenBB platform and its widgets.

classes.name: BillsState
classes.description: Singleton class managing cached bill data within the application.

methods.name: int year_to_congress(year: int)
methods.description: Converts a given year (1935 or later) into the corresponding U.S. Congress session number.

methods.name: str check_api_key()
methods.description: Verifies if the Congress.gov API key is set in user credentials.

methods.name: list download_bills(urls: list[str])
methods.description: Downloads bill PDFs from provided URLs, returning base64-encoded content or errors.

methods.name: Union[dict,list] get_bills_by_type( congress: Optional[int] = None, bill_type: str = "hr", start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, limit: Optional[int] = None, offset: Optional[int] = 0, sort_by: Literal["asc", "desc"] = "desc", )
methods.description: Fetches bills of a specified type and congress, sorted by latest action date.

methods.name: get_all_bills_by_type( congress: Optional[int] = None, bill_type: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Retrieves all bills of a specific type for a given Congress, handling pagination internally.

methods.name: list get_bill_choices( congress: Optional[int] = None, bill_type: Optional[str] = None, start_date: Optional[str] = None, end_date: Optional[str] = None, bill_url: Optional[str] = None, is_document_choices: Optional[bool] = None, )
methods.description: Provides selectable options for bills, used in UI widgets.

methods.name: list get_bill_text_choices(bill_url: str, is_workspace: bool = False)
methods.description: Gets download links for the full text versions of a bill, used in the Congressional Bills Viewer widget.
